def _auction_register_sell_equipment_handlers(bot):

    def auction_sell_start_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = {
            "step": "category",
            "page": 0,
        }

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_auction_sell_start_text(),
            reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb()
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.from_user.id in AUCTION_SELL_STATE)
    def auction_sell_state_router_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text = message.text or ""
        state = AUCTION_SELL_STATE.get(user_id) or {}
        step = state.get("step")

        if text == AUCTION_BACK_TO_MENU_BUTTON:
            clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_house_text(user_id),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
            )
            return

        if text == AUCTION_CANCEL_BUTTON:
            clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ Виставлення товару скасовано.",
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
            )
            return

        if step == "category":
            if text != AUCTION_EQUIPMENT_CATEGORY_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    "Оберіть категорію кнопкою нижче.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb()
                )
                return

            state["step"] = "item"
            state["page"] = 0
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
            list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=0)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
            return

        if step == "item":
            page = int(state.get("page", 0) or 0)

            if text == AUCTION_NEXT_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON:
                page += 1
                state["page"] = page
                AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
                list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            if text == AUCTION_PREV_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON:
                page = max(0, page - 1)
                state["page"] = page
                AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state
                list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_item_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            inventory_id = _auction_parse_inventory_id_from_button(text)
            if not inventory_id:
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    "Оберіть предмет кнопкою нижче.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_items_kb(user_id, page=page)[0]
                )
                return

            from db import get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction, validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment

            validation = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)
            if not validation.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    validation.get("message", "❌ Предмет не можна виставити."),
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_items_kb(user_id, page=page)[0]
                )
                return

            snapshot = validation["snapshot"]
            state["step"] = "price"
            state["inventory_id"] = inventory_id
            state["snapshot"] = snapshot
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_sell_price_prompt(snapshot),
                reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove()
            )
            return

        if step == "price":
            from db import validate_auction_price

            price_result = validate_auction_price(text)
            if not price_result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    price_result.get("message", "❌ Некоректна ціна.") + "\n\nСпробуйте ще раз або напишіть ❌ Скасувати.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb()
                )
                return

            state["step"] = "confirm"
            state["price"] = price_result["price"]
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE[user_id] = state

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_sell_confirm_text(state["snapshot"], price_result["price"]),
                reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb()
            )
            return

        if step == "confirm":
            if text != AUCTION_CONFIRM_LIST_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    "Підтвердіть виставлення або скасуйте дію.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb()
                )
                return

            from db import create_equipment_auction_lot

            result = create_equipment_auction_lot(
                user_id=user_id,
                inventory_id=state.get("inventory_id"),
                price=state.get("price"),
            )

            clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)

            if not result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося створити лот."),
                    reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
                )
                return

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "✅ Лот виставлено на продаж!\n\n"
                    f"📦 {result.get('item_name')}\n"
                    f"💰 Ціна: {result.get('price')} золота\n"
                    "⏳ Термін: 7 днів\n\n"
                    "Предмет перенесено з інвентаря до Торгового Дому."
                ),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
            )
            return

        # Unknown state fallback.
        clear_auction_sell_state(user_id)
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "ℹ️ Стан виставлення товару скинуто.",
            reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
        )

def _auction_register_sell_all_handlers_v2(bot):

    def auction_sell_start_v2(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        clear_auction_sell_state_v2(user_id)
        AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2[user_id] = {
            "step": "category",
            "page": 0,
        }

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_auction_sell_start_text_v2(),
            reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb_v2(),
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.from_user.id in AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2)
    def auction_sell_state_router_v2(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text = message.text or ""
        state = AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2.get(user_id) or {}
        step = state.get("step")

        if text == AUCTION_BACK_TO_MENU_BUTTON:
            clear_auction_sell_state_v2(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_house_text(user_id),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
            )
            return

        if text == AUCTION_CANCEL_BUTTON:
            clear_auction_sell_state_v2(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ Виставлення товару скасовано.",
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
            )
            return

        if step == "category":
            if text not in AUCTION_SELL_CATEGORY_LABELS:
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    "Оберіть категорію кнопкою нижче.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb_v2(),
                )
                return

            category = AUCTION_SELL_CATEGORY_LABELS[text]
            _auction_open_item_list_v2(bot, message, user_id, category, page=0)
            return

        if step == "item":
            category = state.get("category", "equipment")
            page = int(state.get("page", 0) or 0)

            if text == AUCTION_NEXT_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON:
                _auction_open_item_list_v2(bot, message, user_id, category, page=page + 1)
                return

            if text == AUCTION_PREV_SELL_ITEMS_BUTTON:
                _auction_open_item_list_v2(bot, message, user_id, category, page=max(0, page - 1))
                return

            inventory_id = _auction_parse_inventory_id_from_button(text)
            if not inventory_id:
                _auction_open_item_list_v2(bot, message, user_id, category, page=page)
                return

            if category == "equipment":
                from db import validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment

                validation = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)
                if not validation.get("success"):
                    bot.send_message(
                        message.chat.id,
                        validation.get("message", "❌ Предмет не можна виставити."),
                        reply_markup=auction_sell_items_kb(user_id, page=page)[0],
                    )
                    return

                snapshot = validation["snapshot"]
                state.update({
                    "step": "price",
                    "category": category,
                    "inventory_id": inventory_id,
                    "snapshot": snapshot,
                    "quantity": 1,
                })
                AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2[user_id] = state

                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    build_auction_sell_price_prompt(snapshot),
                    reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove(),
                )
                return

            from db import get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction

            snapshot_result = get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction(user_id, inventory_id)
            if not snapshot_result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    snapshot_result.get("message", "❌ Предмет не знайдено."),
                    reply_markup=auction_stack_items_kb_v2(user_id, category, page=page)[0],
                )
                return

            snapshot = snapshot_result["snapshot"]
            state.update({
                "step": "quantity",
                "category": category,
                "inventory_id": inventory_id,
                "snapshot": snapshot,
            })
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2[user_id] = state

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_stack_quantity_prompt_v2(snapshot, category),
                reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove(),
            )
            return

        if step == "quantity":
            category = state.get("category")
            inventory_id = state.get("inventory_id")
            snapshot = state.get("snapshot") or {}

            try:
                quantity = int(text)
            except Exception:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "❌ Введіть кількість числом.")
                return

            from db import validate_inventory_stack_item_for_auction

            validation = validate_inventory_stack_item_for_auction(
                user_id=user_id,
                inventory_id=inventory_id,
                category=category,
                quantity=quantity,
            )
            if not validation.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, validation.get("message", "❌ Некоректна кількість."))
                return

            snapshot = validation["snapshot"]
            state.update({
                "step": "price",
                "quantity": quantity,
                "snapshot": snapshot,
            })
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2[user_id] = state

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_stack_price_prompt_v2(snapshot, quantity),
                reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove(),
            )
            return

        if step == "price":
            from db import validate_auction_price

            price_result = validate_auction_price(text)
            if not price_result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    price_result.get("message", "❌ Некоректна ціна.") + "\n\nСпробуйте ще раз або напишіть ❌ Скасувати.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb(),
                )
                return

            state["step"] = "confirm"
            state["price"] = price_result["price"]
            AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2[user_id] = state

            if state.get("category") == "equipment":
                confirm_text = build_auction_sell_confirm_text(state["snapshot"], price_result["price"])
            else:
                confirm_text = build_auction_stack_confirm_text_v2(
                    state["snapshot"],
                    state.get("quantity", 1),
                    price_result["price"],
                )

            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, confirm_text, reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb())
            return

        if step == "confirm":
            if text != AUCTION_CONFIRM_LIST_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    "Підтвердіть виставлення або скасуйте дію.",
                    reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb(),
                )
                return

            category = state.get("category")

            if category == "equipment":
                from db import create_equipment_auction_lot
                result = create_equipment_auction_lot(
                    user_id=user_id,
                    inventory_id=state.get("inventory_id"),
                    price=state.get("price"),
                )
            else:
                from db import create_stack_auction_lot
                result = create_stack_auction_lot(
                    user_id=user_id,
                    inventory_id=state.get("inventory_id"),
                    category=category,
                    quantity=state.get("quantity"),
                    price=state.get("price"),
                )

            clear_auction_sell_state_v2(user_id)

            if not result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося створити лот."),
                    reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
                )
                return

            quantity_text = ""
            if int(result.get("quantity", 1) or 1) > 1:
                quantity_text = f" x{result.get('quantity')}"

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "✅ Лот виставлено на продаж!\n\n"
                    f"📦 {result.get('item_name')}{quantity_text}\n"
                    f"💰 Ціна: {result.get('price')} золота\n"
                    "⏳ Термін: 7 днів\n\n"
                    "Предмет перенесено з інвентаря до Торгового Дому."
                ),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
            )
            return

        clear_auction_sell_state_v2(user_id)
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "ℹ️ Стан виставлення товару скинуто.",
            reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
        )

def _auction_register_buy_lot_handlers_v1(bot):

        user_id = message.from_user.id

            "step": "list",
            "page": 0,
        }
        text, kb = build_auction_buy_list_text(user_id, page=0)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.from_user.id in AUCTION_BUY_STATE)
    def auction_buy_state_router_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text = message.text or ""
        state = AUCTION_BUY_STATE.get(user_id) or {}
        step = state.get("step")

        if text == AUCTION_BACK_TO_MENU_BUTTON:
            clear_auction_buy_state(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_house_text(user_id),

                state["page"] = page
                AUCTION_BUY_STATE[user_id] = state
                list_text, kb = build_auction_buy_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            if text == AUCTION_PREV_LOTS_BUTTON:
                page = max(0, page - 1)
                state["page"] = page
                AUCTION_BUY_STATE[user_id] = state
                list_text, kb = build_auction_buy_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            lot_id = _auction_parse_lot_id_from_button(text)
            if not lot_id:
                list_text, kb = build_auction_buy_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            from db import build_auction_lot_public_details

            details = build_auction_lot_public_details(lot_id, viewer_user_id=user_id)
            if not details.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    details.get("message", "⚠️ Лот недоступний."),
                    reply_markup=auction_buy_lots_kb(user_id, page=page)[0],
                )
                return

            state["step"] = "view"
            state["lot_id"] = lot_id
            AUCTION_BUY_STATE[user_id] = state

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                details["text"],
                reply_markup=auction_lot_view_kb(),
            )
            return

        if step == "view":
            lot_id = state.get("lot_id")

            if text == AUCTION_LOT_BACK_BUTTON:
                state["step"] = "list"
                AUCTION_BUY_STATE[user_id] = state
                page = int(state.get("page", 0) or 0)
                list_text, kb = build_auction_buy_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            if text != AUCTION_CONFIRM_BUY_BUTTON:
                from db import build_auction_lot_public_details
                details = build_auction_lot_public_details(lot_id, viewer_user_id=user_id)
                if not details.get("success"):
                    clear_auction_buy_state(user_id)
                    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, details.get("message", "⚠️ Лот недоступний."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
                    return
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, details["text"], reply_markup=auction_lot_view_kb())
                return

            from db import build_auction_lot_public_details
            details = build_auction_lot_public_details(lot_id, viewer_user_id=user_id)
            if not details.get("success"):
                clear_auction_buy_state(user_id)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, details.get("message", "⚠️ Лот недоступний."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
                return

            state["step"] = "confirm"
            AUCTION_BUY_STATE[user_id] = state
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_buy_confirm_text(details["text"]),
                reply_markup=auction_lot_view_kb(),
            )
            return

        if step == "confirm":
            lot_id = state.get("lot_id")

            if text in [AUCTION_CANCEL_BUY_BUTTON, AUCTION_LOT_BACK_BUTTON]:
                state["step"] = "view"
                AUCTION_BUY_STATE[user_id] = state
                from db import build_auction_lot_public_details
                details = build_auction_lot_public_details(lot_id, viewer_user_id=user_id)
                if details.get("success"):
                    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, details["text"], reply_markup=auction_lot_view_kb())
                else:
                    clear_auction_buy_state(user_id)
                    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, details.get("message", "⚠️ Лот недоступний."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
                return

            if text != AUCTION_CONFIRM_BUY_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "Підтвердьте покупку або поверніться назад.", reply_markup=auction_lot_view_kb())
                return

            from db import buy_auction_lot

            result = buy_auction_lot(buyer_user_id=user_id, lot_id=lot_id)
            clear_auction_buy_state(user_id)

            if not result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося купити лот."),
                    reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
                )
                return

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "✅ Покупку завершено!\n\n"
                    f"📦 {result.get('item_name')}\n"
                    f"💰 Сплачено: {result.get('price')} золота\n\n"
                    "Предмет додано в інвентар."
                ),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
            )
            return

        clear_auction_buy_state(user_id)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "ℹ️ Стан покупки скинуто.", reply_markup=auction_house_kb())

def _auction_register_sell_inline_handlers_v1(bot):

    def auction_sell_start_inline_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        _auction_clear_all_sell_states_v1(user_id)
        AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE[user_id] = {
            "step": "category",
        }
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_auction_sell_start_text_inline_v1(),
            reply_markup=auction_sell_inline_category_kb_v1(),
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.from_user.id in AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE)
    def auction_sell_inline_state_message_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text = message.text or ""
        state = AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE.get(user_id) or {}
        step = state.get("step")

        if text == AUCTION_BACK_TO_MENU_BUTTON:
            _auction_clear_all_sell_states_v1(user_id)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_auction_house_text(user_id), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
            return

        if text == AUCTION_CANCEL_BUTTON:
            _auction_clear_all_sell_states_v1(user_id)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "❌ Виставлення товару скасовано.", reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
            return

        if step == "category":
            if text not in AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_CATEGORY_BUTTONS:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "Оберіть категорію кнопкою нижче.", reply_markup=auction_sell_inline_category_kb_v1())
                return

            category = AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_CATEGORY_BUTTONS[text]
            state.update({"step": "item_inline", "category": category, "page": 0})
            AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE[user_id] = state
            list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, page=0)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
            return

        if step == "quantity":
            category = state.get("category")
            inventory_id = state.get("inventory_id")

            try:
                quantity = int(text)
            except Exception:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "❌ Введіть кількість числом.")
                return

            from db import validate_inventory_stack_item_for_auction
            validation = validate_inventory_stack_item_for_auction(
                user_id=user_id,
                inventory_id=inventory_id,
                category=category,
                quantity=quantity,
            )

            if not validation.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, validation.get("message", "❌ Некоректна кількість."))
                return

            state.update({
                "step": "price",
                "quantity": quantity,
                "snapshot": validation["snapshot"],
            })
            AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE[user_id] = state
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_auction_stack_price_prompt_v2(validation["snapshot"], quantity), reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove())
            return

        if step == "price":
            from db import validate_auction_price
            price_result = validate_auction_price(text)
            if not price_result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, price_result.get("message", "❌ Некоректна ціна.") + "\n\nСпробуйте ще раз або напишіть ❌ Скасувати.", reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb())
                return

            state["step"] = "confirm"
            state["price"] = price_result["price"]
            AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE[user_id] = state

            if state.get("category") == "equipment":
                confirm_text = build_auction_sell_confirm_text(state["snapshot"], price_result["price"])
            else:
                confirm_text = build_auction_stack_confirm_text_v2(state["snapshot"], state.get("quantity", 1), price_result["price"])

            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, confirm_text, reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb())
            return

        if step == "confirm":
            if text != AUCTION_CONFIRM_LIST_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "Підтвердіть виставлення або скасуйте дію.", reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb())
                return

            category = state.get("category")

            if category == "equipment":
                from db import create_equipment_auction_lot
                result = create_equipment_auction_lot(
                    user_id=user_id,
                    inventory_id=state.get("inventory_id"),
                    price=state.get("price"),
                )
            else:
                from db import create_stack_auction_lot
                result = create_stack_auction_lot(
                    user_id=user_id,
                    inventory_id=state.get("inventory_id"),
                    category=category,
                    quantity=state.get("quantity"),
                    price=state.get("price"),
                )

            _auction_clear_all_sell_states_v1(user_id)

            if not result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося створити лот."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
                return

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "✅ Лот виставлено на продаж!\n\n"
                    f"📦 {result.get('item_name')}\n"
                    f"💰 Ціна: {result.get('price')} золота\n"
                    "⏳ Термін: 7 днів\n\n"
                    "Предмет перенесено з інвентаря до Торгового Дому."
                ),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
            )
            return

        _auction_clear_all_sell_states_v1(user_id)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "ℹ️ Стан виставлення товару скинуто.", reply_markup=auction_house_kb())

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "ah_menu")
    def auction_inline_menu_callback_v1(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        _auction_clear_all_sell_states_v1(user_id)
        _auction_clear_all_buy_states_v1(user_id)
        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        except Exception:
            pass
        bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, build_auction_house_text(user_id), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("ah_sell_page:"))
    def auction_sell_inline_page_callback_v1(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        parts = call.data.split(":")
        category = parts[1]
        page = int(parts[2])
        state = AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE.get(user_id) or {}
        state.update({"step": "item_inline", "category": category, "page": page})
        AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE[user_id] = state
        text, kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, page=page)
        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
            bot.edit_message_text(text, chat_id=call.message.chat.id, message_id=call.message.message_id, reply_markup=kb)
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("ah_sell_item:"))
    def auction_sell_inline_item_callback_v1(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        parts = call.data.split(":")
        category = parts[1]
        inventory_id = int(parts[2])
        page = int(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 else 0

        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if category == "equipment":
            from db import validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment
            validation = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)
            if not validation.get("success"):
                text, kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, page=page)
                bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, validation.get("message", "❌ Предмет не можна виставити."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
                bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            snapshot = validation["snapshot"]
            AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE[user_id] = {
                "step": "price",
                "category": category,
                "inventory_id": inventory_id,
                "snapshot": snapshot,
                "quantity": 1,
                "page": page,
            }
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, build_auction_sell_price_prompt(snapshot), reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove())
            return

        from db import get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction
        snapshot_result = get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction(user_id, inventory_id)
        if not snapshot_result.get("success"):
            text, kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, page=page)
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, snapshot_result.get("message", "❌ Предмет не знайдено."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)
            return

        snapshot = snapshot_result["snapshot"]
        AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE[user_id] = {
            "step": "quantity",
            "category": category,
            "inventory_id": inventory_id,
            "snapshot": snapshot,
            "page": page,
        }
        bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, build_auction_stack_quantity_prompt_v2(snapshot, category), reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove())

def auction_buy_lots_inline_kb_v1(user_id, page=0):
    from db import get_public_auction_lots_for_buyer

    page = max(0, int(page or 0))
    offset = page * AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE
    lots = get_public_auction_lots_for_buyer(
        user_id=user_id,
        limit=AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE + 1,
        offset=offset,
        sort="new",
    )

    visible_lots = lots[:AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE]
    has_next = len(lots) > AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)

    for lot in visible_lots:
        quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)
        qty = f" ×{quantity}" if quantity > 1 and f"×{quantity}" not in lot["item_name"] else ""
        label = f"🛒 {_auction_lot_typed_name_17_1_0(lot)}{qty} — {lot['price']} 💰"
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            _auction_inline_truncate(label),
            callback_data=f"ah_buy_lot:{lot['id']}:{page}"
        ))

    nav = []
    if page > 0:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("⬅️ Назад", callback_data=f"ah_buy_page:{page - 1}"))
    if has_next:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("➡️ Далі", callback_data=f"ah_buy_page:{page + 1}"))
    if nav:
        kb.row(*nav)

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("🔙 Торговий дім", callback_data="ah_menu"))
    return kb, visible_lots, has_next

def _auction_send_sell_category_listing_v1(bot, message, category):
    """Open one sell category through the canonical inline item-list flow."""

    user_id = message.from_user.id
    category = str(category or "").strip().lower()
    allowed_categories = {"equipment", "potion", "material", "rune", "consumable"}

    if category not in allowed_categories:
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "❌ Невідома категорія товару.",
            reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb_v1(),
        )
        return

    # A concrete category must never remain in the persistent reply keyboard.
    # The item list itself is always rendered by InlineKeyboardMarkup.
    bot.send_message(
        message.chat.id,
        "📂 Категорію відкрито. Для повернення до категорій використай inline-кнопку «🔙 Категорії виставлення» під списком.",
        reply_markup=auction_sell_listing_back_kb_v1(),
    )

    try:
        text, inline_kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(
            user_id=user_id,
            category=category,
            page=0,
        )
    except TypeError:
        text, inline_kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, 0)
    except Exception as error:
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            f"❌ Не вдалося відкрити категорію: {error}",
            reply_markup=auction_sell_listing_back_kb_v1(),
        )
        return

    if not isinstance(inline_kb, types.InlineKeyboardMarkup):
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "❌ Список категорії має некоректний формат клавіатури.",
            reply_markup=auction_sell_listing_back_kb_v1(),
        )
        return

    inline_kb = _auction_sanitize_sell_inline_kb_v1(inline_kb)
    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=inline_kb)

def build_auction_market_price_search_text_v1(query):
    from db import search_auction_market_price_stats, format_auction_history_date

    rows = search_auction_market_price_stats(query, limit=10)

    text = (
        "📈 Ринкові ціни\n\n"
        f"Запит: {query}\n\n"
    )

    if not rows:
        text += "Продажів за цим запитом ще не знайдено."
        return text

    lines = []
    for idx, row in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        try:
            avg_price = float(row["avg_price"] or 0)
            min_price = float(row["min_price"] or 0)
            max_price = float(row["max_price"] or 0)
        except Exception:
            avg_price = min_price = max_price = 0.0

        last_sale = format_auction_history_date(row["last_sale_at"], with_time=True)

        lines.append(
            f"{idx}. {row['item_name']}\n"
            f"   Продажів: {row['sales_count']} | Середня: {avg_price:.2f} 💰\n"
            f"   Мін: {min_price:.2f} 💰 | Макс: {max_price:.2f} 💰\n"
            f"   Останній продаж: {last_sale}"
        )

    text += "\n\n".join(lines)
    return text

def build_auction_diagnostics_text_v1(report):
    counts = report.get("status_counts", {}) if isinstance(report, dict) else {}
    active_by_seller = report.get("active_lots_by_seller", []) if isinstance(report, dict) else []

    top_sellers = []
    for row in active_by_seller[:5]:
        top_sellers.append(f"{row.get('seller_user_id')}: {row.get('active_count')}")

    if not top_sellers:
        top_sellers_text = "немає"
    else:
        top_sellers_text = "\n".join(f"• {x}" for x in top_sellers)

    return (
        "🧪 Auction diagnostics\n\n"
        f"Таблиці OK: {'так' if report.get('tables_ok') else 'ні'}\n"
        f"Всього лотів: {report.get('total_lots', 0)}\n\n"
        "Статуси:\n"
        f"• ACTIVE: {counts.get('ACTIVE', 0)}\n"
        f"• SOLD_UNCLAIMED: {counts.get('SOLD_UNCLAIMED', 0)}\n"
        f"• SOLD_CLAIMED: {counts.get('SOLD_CLAIMED', 0)}\n"
        f"• EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED: {counts.get('EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED', 0)}\n"
        f"• EXPIRED_CLAIMED: {counts.get('EXPIRED_CLAIMED', 0)}\n"
        f"• DELETED: {counts.get('DELETED', 0)}\n\n"
        "Потенційні проблеми:\n"

def build_shop_preview_display_name(name, slot_key, armor_type):
    """
    Повертає красиву назву preview-предмета.

    Для броні додає тип у дужках:
    Чоботи 5 рівня -> Чоботи [Тканина] 5 рівня

    Для зброї / off-hand тип у дужках не додається,
    бо назва вже зазвичай містить сам тип:
    Жезл 5 рівня
    Кинджал 5 рівня
    Щит 5 рівня
    """
    if not is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        return name
    if not armor_type:
        return name
    armor_label = get_armor_type_label(armor_type)
    if not armor_label:
        return name
    if f'[{armor_label}]' in name:
        return name
    marker = ' рівня'
    if marker in name:
        index = name.rfind(marker)
        before_level = name[:index]
        after_level = name[index:]
        parts = before_level.rsplit(' ', 1)
        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].isdigit():
            return f'{parts[0]} [{armor_label}] {parts[1]}{after_level}'
    return f'{name} [{armor_label}]'

def _calculate_enemy_turn_15_5_0(
    mob, player_pdef, player_mdef, player_dex, sta, level
):
    """Preserve normal/elite behavior; route bosses through Stage 15 bridge."""
    if not mob.get("is_boss"):
        result = calculate_mob_attack(
            mob_attack=mob["attack"], player_pdef=player_pdef,
            player_mdef=player_mdef, player_dex=player_dex,
            mob_dex=mob["dex"], sta=sta, level=level,
            attack_type=mob["attack_type"]
        )
        result["boss_turn"] = None
        return result
    turn = prepare_boss_turn(mob)
    plan = turn["action_plan"]
    request = build_boss_damage_request(plan)
    if request is None:
        return {
            "damage": 0, "is_crit": False, "is_dodge": False,
            "dodge_chance": 0.0, "boss_turn": turn,
        }
    result = calculate_mob_attack(
        mob_attack=request["mob_attack"], player_pdef=player_pdef,
        player_mdef=player_mdef, player_dex=player_dex,
        mob_dex=mob["dex"], sta=sta, level=level,
        attack_type=request["attack_type"]
    )
    result["boss_turn"] = turn
    return result

def add_enemy_effect(mob, key, effect):
    """Add or refresh one canonical enemy effect without damage stacking."""
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    incoming = dict(effect)
    incoming["key"] = key
    existing = mob["enemy_effects"].get(key)

    if existing is None:
        incoming["fresh"] = True
        mob["enemy_effects"][key] = incoming
        return "applied"

    old_turns = max(0, int(existing.get("turns", 0) or 0))
    new_turns = max(0, int(incoming.get("turns", 0) or 0))
    old_power = max(
        abs(float(existing.get("damage", 0) or 0)),
        abs(float(existing.get("heal", 0) or 0)),
        max((abs(float(value or 0)) for value in existing.get("modifiers", {}).values()), default=0.0),
    )
    new_power = max(
        abs(float(incoming.get("damage", 0) or 0)),
        abs(float(incoming.get("heal", 0) or 0)),
        max((abs(float(value or 0)) for value in incoming.get("modifiers", {}).values()), default=0.0),
    )

    if new_power < old_power:
        return "kept_stronger"

    if new_power == old_power:
        if new_turns > old_turns:
            existing["turns"] = new_turns
            return "refreshed"
        return "unchanged"

    preserved_turns = max(old_turns, new_turns)
    incoming["turns"] = preserved_turns
    if existing.get("fresh", False):
        incoming["fresh"] = True
    else:
        incoming.pop("fresh", None)
    mob["enemy_effects"][key] = incoming
    return "replaced_stronger"

def process_player_turn_start_effects(user_id, mob):
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    # Скільки HoT вилікував саме на старті поточного ходу.
    # Якщо цей самий хід завершиться перемогою, process_victory() відкочує цей тик.
    mob["_turn_start_hot_heal_applied"] = 0

    if not mob["player_effects"]:
        return ""

    text = ""
    effects_to_remove = []

    if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
        current_hp = int(mob["player_hp"])
        max_hp = int(mob["player_max_hp"])
    else:
        current_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
        max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)
        mob["player_hp"] = current_hp
        mob["player_max_hp"] = max_hp

        # Бій почався: пасивна регенерація HP не має накопичуватись під час бою.
        # set_current_hp() також оновлює last_hp_regen_update.
        set_current_hp(user_id, current_hp)

    initial_hp = current_hp
    total_hot_healed = 0

    for key, effect in list(mob["player_effects"].items()):
        effect_type = effect.get("type", "")
        turns = int(effect.get("turns", 0))

        if effect_type == "hot":
            heal = int(effect.get("heal", 0))

            if heal > 0 and current_hp < max_hp:
                prev_hp = current_hp
                current_hp = min(max_hp, current_hp + heal)
                healed = current_hp - prev_hp

                if healed > 0:
                    total_hot_healed += healed
                    text += f"🌿 {effect.get('name', 'Лікування')}: +{healed} HP\n"

        turns -= 1
        effect["turns"] = turns

        if turns <= 0:
            effects_to_remove.append(key)

    if current_hp != initial_hp:
        set_current_hp(user_id, current_hp)
        mob["player_hp"] = current_hp

    mob["_turn_start_hot_heal_applied"] = total_hot_healed

    for key in effects_to_remove:
        name = mob["player_effects"].get(key, {}).get("name", key)
        remove_player_effect(mob, key)
        text += f"⌛ Ефект завершився: {name}\n"

    return text

def apply_player_shield_absorb(mob, damage):
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    if damage <= 0:
        return damage, ""

    text = ""
    remaining_damage = damage

    for key, effect in list(mob["player_effects"].items()):
        if effect.get("type") != "shield":
            continue

        absorb_left = int(effect.get("absorb_left", 0))

        if absorb_left <= 0:
            continue

        absorbed = min(absorb_left, remaining_damage)
        remaining_damage -= absorbed
        absorb_left -= absorbed

        effect["absorb_left"] = absorb_left

        text += f"🧱 {effect.get('name', 'Щит')} поглинув {absorbed} шкоди.\n"

        if absorb_left <= 0:
            name = effect.get("name", "Щит")
            remove_player_effect(mob, key)
            text += f"💥 {name} зруйновано.\n"

        if remaining_damage <= 0:
            remaining_damage = 0
            break

    return remaining_damage, text

def build_combat_potion_kb(user_id, cooldown=0):
    items = get_inventory_detailed(user_id)

    uses_mana = profile_summary.get("resource_type") == "mana"

    try:
        cooldown = max(0, int(cooldown or 0))

        cooldown = 0

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()
    found = False

    for item in items:
        (
            inv_id,
            item_id,
            name,
            type_,
            rarity,
            category,
            quantity,
            max_stack,
            durability,
            b_str,
            b_dex,
            b_int,
            b_wis,
            b_sta,

        ) = item

        is_hp_potion = type_ in ("potion_hp", "potion_hp_medium")
        is_mp_potion = type_ in ("potion_mp", "potion_mp_medium")

        if category != "potion" or not (is_hp_potion or (uses_mana and is_mp_potion)):
            continue

        found = True

        if cooldown > 0:
            button_text = (

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text=button_text,

        return None

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(

    ))

    return kb

def rollback_turn_start_hot_heal_on_victory(user_id, mob):
    """
    Відкочує HoT, який спрацював на початку ходу,
    якщо цей самий хід завершився перемогою.
    """

    if not mob:
        return

    hot_heal = int(mob.get("_turn_start_hot_heal_applied", 0) or 0)

    if hot_heal <= 0:
        return

    if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
        current_hp = int(mob.get("player_hp", 0) or 0)
        max_hp = int(mob.get("player_max_hp", get_max_hp(user_id)) or get_max_hp(user_id))
    else:
        current_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
        max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

    new_hp = current_hp - hot_heal
    new_hp = max(1, min(max_hp, new_hp))

    mob["player_hp"] = new_hp
    mob["player_max_hp"] = max_hp
    mob["_turn_start_hot_heal_applied"] = 0

    set_current_hp(user_id, new_hp)

def finalize_combat_state_before_victory(user_id, mob):
    """
    Фіналізує бойовий стан перед перемогою.

    Перед очищенням бойових ефектів відкочує HoT, який спрацював
    на старті переможного ходу. Потім зберігає поточне HP і очищає
    тимчасові ефекти бою.
    """

    if not mob:
        return

    # A HoT tick applied at the start of the winning turn is legitimate healing.
    # Keep the already-clamped mob["player_hp"] value instead of subtracting it again.
    mob["_turn_start_hot_heal_applied"] = 0

    if "player_hp" in mob:
        try:
            player_hp = int(mob.get("player_hp", 0) or 0)
            player_max_hp = int(mob.get("player_max_hp", get_max_hp(user_id)) or get_max_hp(user_id))

            if player_max_hp <= 0:
                player_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

            player_hp = max(1, min(player_max_hp, player_hp))
            set_current_hp(user_id, player_hp)

            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
            mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp

        except Exception:
            pass

    mob["player_effects"] = {}
    mob["enemy_effects"] = {}
    mob["stunned_turns"] = 0
    mob["_turn_start_hot_heal_applied"] = 0

def process_victory(bot, chat_id, user_id, lvl, mob, prefix_text=""):
    encounter_id = (mob or {}).get("pve_encounter_id")
    if encounter_id and not claim_pve_terminal(user_id, 'victory', encounter_id):
        bot.send_message(chat_id, STALE_COMBAT_TEXT, reply_markup=main_kb())
        return
    # ROM_STAGE_18_29_3F_EVENT_VICTORY_STATISTICS
    event_key = str((mob or {}).get("event_key") or "").strip()
    event_mob_key = str((mob or {}).get("event_mob_key") or "").strip()
    if encounter_id and event_key and event_mob_key:
        from db_modules.connection import conn as event_statistics_conn
        from systems.event_statistics_system import record_event_mob_victory
        record_event_mob_victory(
            event_statistics_conn,
            event_key=event_key,
            user_id=user_id,
            mob_key=event_mob_key,
            terminal_event_id=encounter_id,
        )
        event_statistics_conn.commit()
    """
    Завершення бою перемогою.

    Перед виходом із бою фіксуємо поточне HP з бойового стану
    і очищаємо тимчасові бойові ефекти.

    Це виправляє кейс, коли жрець наклав HoT у фінальному раунді,
    а залишкові тіки лікування некоректно доліковували героя після перемоги.
    """

    finalize_combat_state_before_victory(
        user_id=user_id,
        mob=mob
    )

    if hasattr(bot, "user_data") and user_id in bot.user_data:
        del bot.user_data[user_id]

    reward = process_victory_reward(
        user_id=user_id,
        player_level=lvl,
        mob=mob
    )

    if mob.get("is_boss"):
        encounter_id = mob.get("pve_encounter_id")
        if encounter_id:
            from systems.world_chronicle_system import (
                get_character_name_snapshot,
                record_world_chronicle_event,
            )
            character_name = get_character_name_snapshot(user_id)
            if character_name:
                record_world_chronicle_event(
                    "location_boss_defeated",
                    user_id,
                    character_name,
                    f"location_boss_defeated:{encounter_id}",
                    subject_key=str(mob.get("boss_key") or ""),
                    subject_name_snapshot=str(mob.get("name") or mob.get("base_name") or "Бос"),
                    location_id=str(mob.get("location_id") or ""),
                )

    # The RNG encounter has already passed the canonical terminal claim. A
    # matching ACTIVE BOSS quest now completes and rewards exactly once.
    story_boss_result = process_rng_boss_story_completion(
        user_id=user_id,
        mob=mob,
        location_id=get_current_location(user_id),
        encounter_id=encounter_id,
    )

    wear_result = apply_random_durability_wear_on_victory(
        user_id=user_id,
        chance_percent=25
    )

    contract_result = process_contract_progress_on_kill(
        user_id=user_id,
        mob=mob
    )

    daily_result = process_daily_quest_progress_on_kill(
        user_id=user_id,
        mob=mob
    )

    # Terminal victory was already claimed above, so this hook runs once per
    # encounter and cannot double-count repeated Telegram terminal updates.
    story_region_result = process_region_kill_story_progress(
        user_id=user_id,
        location_id=get_current_location(user_id),
    )

    # Dedicated quest items are rolled after the same terminal claim and never
    # enter ordinary inventory or consume bag capacity.
    story_item_result = process_story_quest_item_drop(
        user_id=user_id,
        location_id=get_current_location(user_id),
    )

    # Combat EXP was awarded before story progress. Evaluate the resulting level
    # only after this terminal victory's progress/drop hooks have run.
    exp_result = reward.get("exp_result") or {}
    resulting_level = int(exp_result.get("level") or get_player_level(user_id))
    story_skip_result = process_overlevel_story_quest_skip(
        user_id=user_id,
        current_level=resulting_level,
    )

    text = build_victory_text(
        user_id=user_id,
        lvl=lvl,
        mob=mob,
        reward=reward,
        wear_result=wear_result,
        contract_result=contract_result,
        daily_result=daily_result,
        prefix_text=prefix_text
    )

    bot.send_message(
        chat_id,
        text,
        reply_markup=main_kb()
    )

    # Quest-item persistence is owned by the drop system. Telegram output is a
    # separate consumer and is emitted exactly once only for an actual grant.
    if int(story_item_result.get("granted", 0) or 0) > 0:
        story_drop_message = str(story_item_result.get("drop_message") or "").strip()
        if story_drop_message:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, story_drop_message)

    exp_result = reward.get("exp_result") or {}
    reward_message = str(exp_result.get("level_up_reward_message") or "").strip()
    level_ups = int(exp_result.get("level_ups", 0) or 0)
    if level_ups > 0 and not reward_message:
        # Some levels have no special milestone item message. Always announce
        # the canonical level transition and permanent attribute-point reward.
        old_level = int(exp_result.get("old_level", resulting_level - level_ups) or 0)
        new_level = int(exp_result.get("level", resulting_level) or resulting_level)
        points = int(exp_result.get("attribute_points_awarded", level_ups * 5) or 0)
        reward_message = (
            "🎉 Рівень підвищено!\n\n"
            f"🏆 Рівень: {old_level} → {new_level}\n"
            f"🌟 Вільні очки характеристик: +{points}"
        )
    if reward_message:
        bot.send_message(chat_id, reward_message)

    # Emit one campaign-level summary only after the level-up notification.
    # The lifecycle mutation is already committed and idempotent.
    story_skip_message = str((story_skip_result or {}).get("message") or "").strip()
    if story_skip_message:
        bot.send_message(chat_id, story_skip_message)

def register_combat_handlers(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: getattr(m, "text", None) == BOSS_CALL_BUTTON)
    def call_active_story_boss(message):
        """Start the canonical location boss only while its story quest is ACTIVE.

        Eligibility is revalidated on every press. After a successful kill,
        Stage 19.19 immediately marks the quest COMPLETED, so stale buttons and
        deliberate delayed turn-in cannot be used to farm guaranteed summons.
        Defeat or escape leaves the quest ACTIVE and permits another attempt.
        """
        user_id = int(message.from_user.id)
        location_id = get_current_location(user_id)
        call = get_active_story_boss_call(user_id=user_id, current_location_id=location_id)
        if not call.get("allowed"):
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "⚠️ Виклик сюжетного боса зараз недоступний.", reply_markup=main_kb())
            return
        if get_active_pve_encounter(user_id) is not None:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "⚔️ Спочатку заверши поточний бій.", reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb())
            return
        stats=get_player_stats(user_id)
        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id,"❗ Спочатку натисни /start",reply_markup=main_kb());return
        lvl=int(stats[-1]);current_hp=get_current_hp_raw(user_id);max_hp=get_max_hp(user_id)
        if max_hp<=0 or (current_hp/max_hp)*100<=25:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id,"😴 Здоров’я занадто низьке для виклику боса.",reply_markup=main_kb());return
        mob=build_location_boss(location_id,lvl)
        if str(mob.get("boss_key")) != str(call.get("boss_key")):
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id,"⚠️ Ціль сюжетного квесту не відповідає босу цієї локації.",reply_markup=main_kb());return
        mob.update({"potion_cooldown":0,"stunned_turns":0,"skill_cooldowns":{},"enemy_effects":{},"player_effects":{},"last_skill_spent_rage":0,"last_skill_spent_combo":0,"player_hp":current_hp,"player_max_hp":max_hp,"story_boss_call":True})
        init_class_combat_resource(user_id,mob);init_combat_effects(mob)
        encounter=begin_pve_encounter(user_id,message.chat.id,mob)
        mob["pve_encounter_id"]=encounter["encounter_id"];mob["pve_started_at"]=encounter["started_at"];mob["pve_deadline_at"]=encounter["deadline_at"]
        bot.user_data=getattr(bot,"user_data",{});bot.user_data[user_id]=mob
        # Match the canonical hunt startup: replace the persistent location
        # keyboard with the combat placeholder before showing inline actions.
        # This prevents Hunt, Map, Profile and Look Around from remaining usable
        # while the guaranteed story-boss encounter is active.
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "⚔️ Бій розпочався!",
            reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb(),
        )
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            f"👑 Голова Найманців викликає {mob['name']}!\n\n"
            "Після перемоги потрібно повернутися до Голови Найманців із доповіддю, "
            "а повторний гарантований виклик стане недоступним.",
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id,mob),
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "🔎 Полювання")
    def hunt(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        from systems.travel_system import is_user_travelling
        if is_user_travelling(user_id):
            from keyboards import map_kb
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "🚶 Полювання недоступне під час подорожі.\n\n"
                    "Відкрий мапу, щоб оновити час у дорозі "
                    "або скасувати маршрут."
                ),
                reply_markup=map_kb(),
            )
            return
        if not _combat_message_allowed_11_3_1(message):
            return

        current_location = get_current_location(user_id)
        if current_location == "city":
            from keyboards import city_kb
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "🏙️ У Місті не можна полювати. Відкрий 🗺️ Мапу та вирушай у доступну локацію.",
                reply_markup=city_kb(),
            )
            return

        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)


        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Спочатку натисни /start",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats

        current_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
        max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

        hp_percent = 0

        if max_hp > 0:
            hp_percent = (current_hp / max_hp) * 100

        if hp_percent <= 25:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "😴 Ви занадто слабкі для полювання.\n\n"
                    f"❤️ Здоров’я: {current_hp}/{max_hp} ({hp_percent:.1f}%)\n"
                    "Ваше здоров’я нижче або дорівнює 25%.\n\n"
                    "Відпочиньте або використайте зілля!"
                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        location_id = get_current_location(user_id)
        location = LOCATIONS.get(location_id, LOCATIONS["start_path"])
        location_max_level = int(location.get("level_max", lvl))

        if lvl > location_max_level:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    f"🌿 Ця місцевість більше не становить для тебе виклику.\n\n"
                    f"📍 Локація: {location['name']}\n"
                    f"🏷 Рівні локації: {location.get('level_min', 1)}–{location_max_level}\n"
                    f"👤 Твій рівень: {lvl}\n\n"
                    f"Ти занадто сильний для полювання тут.\n"
                    f"Відкрий 🗺️ Мапу та перейди до складнішої локації."
                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        energy_result = consume_energy_for_hunt(user_id)

        if not energy_result["success"]:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                energy_result["message"],
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        mob = generate_mob(player_level=lvl, location_id=location_id)
        mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]
        mob["potion_cooldown"] = 0
        mob["stunned_turns"] = 0
        mob["skill_cooldowns"] = {}
        mob["enemy_effects"] = {}
        mob["player_effects"] = {}
        mob["last_skill_spent_rage"] = 0
        mob["last_skill_spent_combo"] = 0
        mob["player_hp"] = current_hp
        mob["player_max_hp"] = max_hp

        init_class_combat_resource(user_id, mob)
        init_combat_effects(mob)

        bot.user_data = getattr(bot, "user_data", {})
        encounter = begin_pve_encounter(user_id, message.chat.id, mob)
        mob["pve_encounter_id"] = encounter["encounter_id"]
        mob["pve_started_at"] = encounter["started_at"]
        mob["pve_deadline_at"] = encounter["deadline_at"]
        bot.user_data[user_id] = mob

        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)

        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)

        attack_type_text = "Фізична" if mob["attack_type"] == "physical" else "Магічна"
        player_attack_type_text = "Фізична" if attack_profile["attack_type"] == "physical" else "Магічна"

        elite_text = ""

        if mob.get("is_boss"):
            elite_text = (
                "👑 БОС ЛОКАЦІЇ!\n"
                "⚠️ Надзвичайно небезпечний ворог із унікальними навичками та фазою Люті.\n\n"
            )
        elif mob.get("is_elite"):
            elite_text = (
                "⭐ ЕЛІТНИЙ ВОРОГ!\n"
                "Ця істота значно сильніша за звичайну.\n\n"
            )

        weapon_text = attack_profile.get("weapon_text") or "Без зброї"
        class_resource_text = get_class_resource_line(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Без імені"

        text = (
            f"📍 Мапа: {location['name']}\n"
            f"🔎 Ти зустрів {mob['name']}\n\n"
            f"{elite_text}"
            f"======================\n\n"

            f"👤 {character_name}\n"
            f"❤️ Здоров’я: {current_hp}/{max_hp}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(current_hp, max_hp)}\n"
            f"{class_resource_text}"
            f"⚔️ Тип атаки: {player_attack_type_text}\n"
            f"🗡️ Зброя: {weapon_text}\n"
            f"💥 Атака: {attack_profile['display_attack']}\n"
            f"🛡 Фіз. захист: {player_pdef}\n"
            f"🔮 Маг. захист: {player_mdef}\n\n"

            f"----------------------\n\n"

            f"👹 {mob['name']}\n"
            f"🏷 Рівень: {mob['level']}\n"
            f"❤️ Здоров’я: {mob['hp']}/{mob['max_hp']}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(mob['hp'], mob['max_hp'])}\n"
            f"⚔️ Атака: {mob['attack']}\n"
            f"🛡 Фіз. захист: {mob.get('pdef', mob.get('def', 0))}\n"
            f"🔮 Маг. захист: {mob.get('mdef', mob.get('def', 0))}\n"
            f"🎯 Тип атаки: {attack_type_text}\n\n"

            f"⚔️ Бій починається!"
        )

        # Спочатку показуємо фальшиву клавіатуру, щоб системна не з'являлася
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "⚔️ Бій розпочався!",
            reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb()
        )
        # Потім показуємо повідомлення про бій з inline меню
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "⚔️ Бій триває...")
    def combat_placeholder(message):
        # Обробник для фальшивої кнопки — нічого не робимо, просто відповідаємо
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        if hasattr(bot, "user_data") and user_id in bot.user_data:
            mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "Використовуй інлайн кнопки для бою!",
                reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb()
            )
        else:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "Ти не в бою!",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "⚔️ Атакувати")
    def attack(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Спочатку почни полювання",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Без імені"

        cooldown_start_text = tick_skill_cooldowns_at_player_turn(mob)
        player_effects_text = process_player_turn_start_effects(user_id, mob)
        player_effects_text += _apply_boss_dot_at_player_turn_15_5_0(mob)
        resource_start_text = regenerate_class_resource_at_player_turn(mob)

        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❗ Персонажа не знайдено",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats

        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)

        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)

        # Використовуємо здоров'я з mob, якщо воно там є, інакше з бази (на випадок старих сесій)
        if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
            player_hp = mob["player_hp"]
            player_max_hp = mob["player_max_hp"]
        else:
            player_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
            player_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp

def build_contracts_text(user_id):
    status = get_contract_status(user_id)

    if not status["exists"]:
        return status["message"], None

    level = status["level"]
    unlocked = status["unlocked"]
    completed_today = status["completed_today"]
    daily_limit = status["daily_limit"]
    active_contract = status["active_contract"]

    text = (
        f"📜 Дошка контрактів\n\n"
        f"На дошці висять замовлення від варти, торговців і мандрівників.\n"
        f"Тут можна взяти щоденне завдання на конкретну істоту.\n\n"
        f"📆 Сьогодні здано контрактів: {completed_today}/{daily_limit}\n"
    )

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()

    if not unlocked:
        text += (
            f"\n🔒 Контракти відкриються з 5 рівня.\n"
            f"👤 Твій рівень: {level}\n\n"
            f"Поки що варто навчитися основам: полюванню, зіллям, "
            f"екіпіруванню та ремонту спорядження."
        )

        return text, kb

    if active_contract:
        completed = active_contract.get("completed", False)

        if completed:
            text += (
                f"\n✅ Контракт виконано!\n\n"
                f"📌 Контракт готовий до здачі:\n"
                f"🎯 Ціль: {active_contract['target_mob_name']}\n"
                f"🏷 Рівень цілі: {active_contract['target_mob_level']}\n"
                f"📈 Прогрес: "
                f"{active_contract['current_kills']}/{active_contract['target_kills']}\n"
                f"✨ Нагорода: {active_contract['reward_exp']} EXP\n\n"
                f"Повернення до Гільдії Найманців підтверджує виконання контракту."
            )

            kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
                text="🎁 Здати контракт",
                callback_data="contract_claim"
            ))

            return text, kb

        text += (
            f"\n📌 Активний контракт:\n"
            f"🎯 Ціль: {active_contract['target_mob_name']}\n"
            f"🏷 Рівень цілі: {active_contract['target_mob_level']}\n"
            f"📈 Прогрес: "
            f"{active_contract['current_kills']}/{active_contract['target_kills']}\n"
            f"✨ Нагорода після здачі: {active_contract['reward_exp']} EXP\n\n"
            f"ℹ️ Прогрес зараховується тільки за вбивство саме цієї істоти.\n"
            f"⭐ Елітна версія цієї істоти також зараховується."
        )

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="❌ Скасувати контракт",
            callback_data="contract_abandon"
        ))

        return text, kb

    if completed_today >= daily_limit:
        text += (
            f"\n✅ Ліміт контрактів на сьогодні виконано.\n"
            f"Повертайся завтра за новими завданнями."
        )

        return text, kb

    text += (
        f"\n✅ Можна взяти новий контракт.\n"
        f"ℹ️ 1 контракт = досвід за 20 мобів твого рівня.\n"
        f"🎯 Ціль буде обрана випадково серед істот, "
        f"які доступні для твого рівня та відкритих локацій."
    )

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="📜 Взяти контракт",
        callback_data="contract_take"
    ))

    return text, kb

def register_contract_handlers(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "📜 Контракти")
    def show_contracts(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "📜 Ти підійшов до дошки контрактів.",
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "contract_take")
    def take_contract(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        status = get_contract_status(user_id)

        if not status["exists"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                status["message"],
                reply_markup=contracts_kb()
            )
            return

        if not status["unlocked"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                (
                    f"🔒 Контракти відкриються з 5 рівня.\n"
                    f"👤 Твій рівень: {status['level']}"
                ),
                reply_markup=contracts_kb()
            )
            return

        chosen_mob = choose_random_contract_mob(status["level"])

        if not chosen_mob:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "❌ Не вдалося знайти доступного моба для контракту.",
                reply_markup=contracts_kb()
            )
            return

        target_mob_name = chosen_mob.get("name", "Невідома істота")
        target_mob_level = int(chosen_mob.get("level", status["level"]))

        result = create_daily_contract(
            user_id=user_id,
            target_mob_name=target_mob_name,
            target_mob_level=target_mob_level
        )

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "contract_claim")
    def claim_contract(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        result = claim_contract_reward(user_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        reward_message = str(result.get("level_up_reward_message") or "")
        if reward_message:
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, reward_message)

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "contract_abandon")
    def abandon_contract(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        result = abandon_active_contract(user_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

def register_dev_handlers(bot):

    # ==============================
    # /give item_id quantity
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["give"])
    def give_item(message):
        if not DEV_MODE:
            return

        user_id = message.from_user.id
        parts = message.text.split()

        if len(parts) < 2:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "❌ Формат:\n"
                    "/give item_id [quantity]\n\n"
                    "Приклад:\n"
                    "/give 201 5"
                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        try:
            item_id = int(parts[1])
            quantity = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) >= 3 else 1
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ item_id і quantity мають бути числами.",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        if quantity < 1:
            quantity = 1

        result = add_item(user_id, item_id, quantity)

        if not result.get("success"):
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося видати предмет."),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        text = (
            f"✅ DEV: предмет видано.\n\n"
            f"📦 {result.get('name', 'Предмет')} x{result.get('added', 0)}\n"
            f"🎒 Сумка: {result.get('used_slots', 0)}/{result.get('capacity', 20)}"
        )

        if result.get("lost", 0) > 0:
            text += f"\n⚠️ Не влізло: x{result.get('lost', 0)}"

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    # ==============================
    # /setlevel N
    # /lvl N
    # /level N
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["setlevel", "lvl", "level"])
    def set_level(message):
        if not DEV_MODE:
            return

        user_id = message.from_user.id
        parts = message.text.split()

        if len(parts) < 2:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "❌ Формат:\n"
                    "/setlevel 5\n"
                    "/lvl 5\n"
                    "/level 5"
                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        target_level = parts[1]
        result = set_player_level_for_test(user_id, target_level)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    # ==============================
    # /resetlevel
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["resetlevel"])
    def reset_level(message):
        if not DEV_MODE:
            return

        user_id = message.from_user.id
        result = reset_player_level_for_test(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    # ==============================
    # /resethero CONFIRM
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["resethero"])
    def reset_hero(message):
        if not DEV_MODE:
            return

        user_id = message.from_user.id
        parts = message.text.split()

        if len(parts) < 2 or parts[1] != "CONFIRM":
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "⚠️ Повне скидання героя\n\n"
                    "Ця команда видалить:\n"
                    "• рівень і EXP\n"
                    "• золото\n"
                    "• інвентар\n"
                    "• екіпірування\n"
                    "• контракти\n"
                    "• щоденні завдання\n\n"
                    "Щоб підтвердити, введи:\n"
                    "/resethero CONFIRM"
                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        result = reset_hero_for_test(user_id)

        if result.get("success"):
            runtime_user_data = getattr(bot, "user_data", None)
            if isinstance(runtime_user_data, dict):
                runtime_user_data.pop(user_id, None)

            from handlers.start import PENDING_CHARACTER_NAME
            PENDING_CHARACTER_NAME.discard(user_id)
            PENDING_CHARACTER_NAME.add(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    # ==============================
    # /progress
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["progress"])
    def progress(message):
        if not DEV_MODE:
            return

        user_id = message.from_user.id
        progress_data = get_user_progress(user_id)

        if not progress_data:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "❌ Персонажа не знайдено. Натисни /start.",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )

def handle_guild_creation_message(bot, message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    text = (message.text or "").strip()
    state = get_guild_create_state(user_id)

    if not state:
        return False

    if text in ["❌ Скасувати створення", "🔙 Зала Гільдій", "🔙 Місто"]:
        reset_guild_create_state(user_id)
        if text == "🔙 Місто":
            send_city(bot, message)
        else:
            open_guild_hall(bot, message.chat.id, user_id)
        return True

    if text == "✏️ Почати заново":
        start_guild_create_state(user_id)
        send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, build_guild_create_name_prompt(user_id))
        return True

    step = state.get("step")

    if step == "name":
        ok, result = validate_guild_name_for_ui(text)
        if not ok:
            send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, result + "\n\nСпробуй ввести іншу назву.")
            return True
        state["name"] = result
        state["step"] = "tag"
        send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, build_guild_create_tag_prompt(state["name"]))
        return True

    if step == "tag":
        ok, result = validate_guild_tag_for_ui(text)
        if not ok:
            send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, result + "\n\nСпробуй ввести інший TAG.")
            return True
        state["tag"] = result
        state["step"] = "icon"
        send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, build_guild_create_icon_prompt(state["name"], state["tag"]))
        return True

    if step == "icon":
        ok, result = validate_guild_icon_for_ui(text)
        if not ok:
            send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, result + "\n\nСпробуй надіслати один emoji.")
            return True
        state["icon"] = result
        state["step"] = "confirm"
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_guild_create_confirm_text(state, user_id), reply_markup=guild_create_confirm_kb())
        return True

    if step == "confirm":
        if text != "✅ Створити гільдію":
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "Натисни ✅ Створити гільдію або скасуй створення.", reply_markup=guild_create_confirm_kb())
            return True

        result = create_guild(user_id=user_id, name=state.get("name", ""), tag=state.get("tag", ""), icon=state.get("icon", "🏰"))
        reset_guild_create_state(user_id)

        if result.get("success"):
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", "✅ Гільдію створено."), reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(user_id))
            open_guild_hall(bot, message.chat.id, user_id)
        else:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", "❌ Не вдалося створити гільдію."), reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(user_id))
        return True

    return False
