def main():
    root = root_dir()
    before = {name: sha(root / name) for name in ("game.db", "game.db-wal")}
    modules = []
    missing = []
    syntax_errors = []
    for rel in TARGET_MODULES:
        path = root / rel
        if not path.exists():
            missing.append(rel)
            continue
        try:
            modules.append(analyze_module(path, rel))
        except SyntaxError as error:
            syntax_errors.append({"module": rel, "error": str(error)})

    all_functions = [f for m in modules for f in m["functions"]]
    counts = Counter()
    for f in all_functions:
        counts.update(f["classification"])
    summary = {
        "modules_expected": len(TARGET_MODULES),
        "modules_found": len(modules),
        "functions": len(all_functions),
        "pure_candidates": counts["PURE_CANDIDATE"],
        "safe_exact": sum(1 for f in all_functions if f["safe_for_exact_simulation"]),
        "adapter_required": counts["ADAPTER_REQUIRED"],
        "rng_injection_required": counts["RNG_INJECTION_REQUIRED"],
        "clock_injection_required": counts["CLOCK_INJECTION_REQUIRED"],
        "read_only_db": counts["READ_ONLY_DB"],
        "mutating_db": counts["MUTATING_DB"],
        "telegram_dependent": counts["TELEGRAM_DEPENDENT"] + counts["TELEGRAM_MODULE"],
    }
    blockers = []
    critical = {"systems/combat_system.py", "systems/player_system.py", "systems/reward_system.py", "systems/equipment_system.py"}
    for rel in missing:
        if rel in critical:
            blockers.append({"code": "missing_critical_module", "message": rel})
    for item in syntax_errors:
        blockers.append({"code": "syntax_error", "message": f"{item['module']}: {item['error']}"})
    if not all_functions:
        blockers.append({"code": "no_functions", "message": "No functions analyzed"})

    result = {
        "version": VERSION,
        "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "verdict": "FAIL" if blockers else "PASS",
        "blockers": blockers,
        "missing_modules": missing,
        "syntax_errors": syntax_errors,
        "summary": summary,
        "policies": {
            "pvp_deferred": True,
            "inventory_capacity_baseline": 40,
            "inventory_capacity_experiment": 60,
            "inventory_reserve_slots": 2,
            "hp_potion_threshold": 0.30,
            "mp_potion_threshold": 0.25,
            "repair_threshold_strictly_below": 10,
            "mob_level_delta": [-1, 0, 1],
            "energy_max": 40,
            "energy_regen_minutes": 5,
            "profiles": {"casual": "18:00-21:00", "regular": "17:00-23:00", "hardcore": "09:00-23:00"},
        },
        "modules": modules,
        "database_files_before": before,
    }

    write_json(root / "SIMULATION_CALLABILITY_MATRIX.json", result)
    (root / "MD").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / "MD/SIMULATION_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md").write_text(build_architecture_md(result), encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "MD/SIMULATION_MVP_POLICY_SPECIFICATION.md").write_text(build_policy_md(), encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "MD/SIMULATION_IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md").write_text(roadmap(result), encoding="utf-8")

    after = {name: sha(root / name) for name in ("game.db", "game.db-wal")}
    strict_unchanged = before == after
    result["database_files_after"] = after
    result["database_files_unchanged"] = strict_unchanged
    if not strict_unchanged:
        result["verdict"] = "FAIL"
        result["blockers"].append({"code": "database_changed", "message": "game.db or WAL changed during AST-only audit"})
    write_json(root / "SIMULATION_CALLABILITY_MATRIX.json", result)

    output_paths = [root / x for x in OUTPUTS[:-1]]
    manifest_lines = [
        f"version={VERSION}",
        f"generated_at={result['generated_at']}",
        f"verdict={result['verdict']}",
        f"functions_analyzed={summary['functions']}",
        f"pure_candidates={summary['pure_candidates']}",
        f"adapter_required={summary['adapter_required']}",
        f"rng_injection_required={summary['rng_injection_required']}",
        f"clock_injection_required={summary['clock_injection_required']}",
        f"database_files_unchanged={str(strict_unchanged).lower()}",
        "pvp_deferred=true",
        "inventory_capacity_baseline=40",
        "inventory_capacity_experiment=60",
    ]
    for path in output_paths:
        info = sha(path)
        manifest_lines.append(f"file={path.relative_to(root)}|size={info['size']}|sha256={info['sha256']}")
    manifest_path = root / OUTPUTS[-1]
    manifest_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest_path.write_text("\n".join(manifest_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    print("[OK] ROM simulation architecture and purity audit")
    print(f"- verdict: {result['verdict']}")
    print(f"- modules: {summary['modules_found']}/{summary['modules_expected']}")
    print(f"- functions analyzed: {summary['functions']}")
    print(f"- pure candidates: {summary['pure_candidates']}")
    print(f"- adapter required: {summary['adapter_required']}")
    print(f"- seeded RNG injection required: {summary['rng_injection_required']}")
    print(f"- SimulationClock injection required: {summary['clock_injection_required']}")
    print(f"- game.db/WAL unchanged: {'YES' if strict_unchanged else 'NO'}")
    print("- PvP: DEFERRED")
    print("- inventory scenarios: 40 baseline / 60 experiment")
    print("- report: MD\\SIMULATION_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md")
    print("- policy: MD\\SIMULATION_MVP_POLICY_SPECIFICATION.md")
    print("- roadmap: MD\\SIMULATION_IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md")
    print("- matrix: SIMULATION_CALLABILITY_MATRIX.json")
    if result["blockers"]:
        for finding in result["blockers"]:
            print(f"  [BLOCKER] {finding['code']}: {finding['message']}")
    if result["verdict"] != "PASS":
        raise SystemExit(2)

def main():
    talk = quest("q1", 1, QuestType.TALK)
    kill = quest("q2", 2, QuestType.KILL_REGION, "q1", target_quantity=2)
    item = quest(
        "q3", 3, QuestType.QUEST_ITEM, "q2", target_quantity=2,
        turn_in_npc_id="elder",
        quest_item=QuestItemDefinition("wolf_clue", "Wolf Clue", 2, 0.5),
        navigation=NavigationDefinition("start_path", "elder", "elder"),
    )
    registry = build_story_quest_registry(((talk, kill, item),))

    db = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    db.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    db.execute("CREATE TABLE users(user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)")
    apply_schema(db)
    db.execute("INSERT INTO users(user_id) VALUES(1)")
    db.commit()

    assert get_story_quest_status(
        db, user_id=1, quest=talk, player_level=1
    ).value == "AVAILABLE"
    assert get_story_quest_status(
        db, user_id=1, quest=kill, player_level=1
    ).value == "LOCKED"

    accepted = accept_story_quest(
        db, registry=registry, user_id=1, quest_id="q1", player_level=1,
        timestamp="2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
    )
    assert accepted["status"] == "ACTIVE"
    assert accept_story_quest(
        db, registry=registry, user_id=1, quest_id="q1", player_level=1,
    )["id"] == accepted["id"]
    expect_unavailable(lambda: accept_story_quest(
        db, registry=registry, user_id=1, quest_id="q2", player_level=1,
    ))

    # The completion service is a later stage. Seed finalized predecessor rows
    # directly only inside this isolated checker to exercise subsequent states.
    db.execute("UPDATE user_story_quests SET status='COMPLETED', reward_claimed=1 WHERE quest_id='q1'")
    db.commit()
    accept_story_quest(db, registry=registry, user_id=1, quest_id="q2", player_level=1)
    assert advance_region_kill_progress(
        db, registry=registry, user_id=1, location_id="dark_forest"
    )["reason"] == "location_mismatch"
    assert advance_region_kill_progress(
        db, registry=registry, user_id=1, location_id="start_path"
    )["progress"] == 1
    final_kill = advance_region_kill_progress(
        db, registry=registry, user_id=1, location_id="start_path", amount=5
    )
    assert final_kill["progress"] == 2 and final_kill["objective_complete"]

    db.execute("UPDATE user_story_quests SET status='COMPLETED', reward_claimed=1 WHERE quest_id='q2'")
    db.commit()
    accept_story_quest(db, registry=registry, user_id=1, quest_id="q3", player_level=1)
    assert collect_active_quest_item(
        db, registry=registry, user_id=1, location_id="start_path",
        item_key="wrong",
    )["reason"] == "item_key_mismatch"
    collected = collect_active_quest_item(
        db, registry=registry, user_id=1, location_id="start_path",
        item_key="wolf_clue", amount=5,
    )
    assert collected["quantity"] == 2 and collected["objective_complete"]
    view = get_story_quest_view(db, user_id=1, quest=item, player_level=1)
    assert view["status"] == "ACTIVE" and view["quest_item_quantity"] == 2

    assert skip_overlevel_active_quest(
        db, registry=registry, user_id=1, current_level=5,
        location_max_levels={"start_path": 5},
    ) is None
    skipped = skip_overlevel_active_quest(
        db, registry=registry, user_id=1, current_level=6,
        location_max_levels={"start_path": 5},
    )
    assert skipped["status"] == "SKIPPED" and skipped["reward_claimed"] == 0
    assert db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_story_quest_items").fetchone()[0] == 0
    assert db.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall() == []
    db.close()
    print("[PASS] story quest lifecycle engine")

def new_db(user_id):
    connection=sqlite3.connect(":memory:"); connection.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    connection.execute("CREATE TABLE users(user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)")
    schema(connection); connection.execute("INSERT INTO users(user_id,level) VALUES(?,1)",(user_id,)); connection.commit()
    return connection

def main():
    combat_source,victory=function("handlers/combat.py","process_victory")
    assert victory.count("process_overlevel_story_quest_skip(")==1
    ordered=("process_victory_reward","process_region_kill_story_progress",
             "process_story_quest_item_drop","process_overlevel_story_quest_skip",
             "build_victory_text")
    positions=[victory.index(token) for token in ordered]
    assert positions==sorted(positions)
    assert 'reward.get("exp_result")' in victory
    assert 'get_player_level(user_id)' in victory

    quest,registry=fixture_registry(); db=new_db(1)
    accept_story_quest(db,registry=registry,user_id=1,quest_id=quest.quest_id,player_level=1)
    collect_active_quest_item(db,registry=registry,user_id=1,location_id="start_path",item_key="fixture_item")
    not_skipped=process_overlevel_story_quest_skip(user_id=1,current_level=5,registry=registry,connection=db,location_max_levels={"start_path":5})
    assert not_skipped is None
    skipped=process_overlevel_story_quest_skip(user_id=1,current_level=6,registry=registry,connection=db,location_max_levels={"start_path":5})
    assert skipped["status"]=="SKIPPED" and skipped["reward_claimed"]==0
    assert db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_story_quest_items WHERE user_id=1").fetchone()[0]==0
    db.close()

    quest2,registry2=fixture_registry(); db2=new_db(2)
    accept_story_quest(db2,registry=registry2,user_id=2,quest_id=quest2.quest_id,player_level=1)
    db2.execute("UPDATE user_story_quests SET status='COMPLETED', reward_claimed=1 WHERE user_id=2")
    db2.commit()
    assert process_overlevel_story_quest_skip(user_id=2,current_level=6,registry=registry2,connection=db2,location_max_levels={"start_path":5}) is None
    row=db2.execute("SELECT status,reward_claimed FROM user_story_quests WHERE user_id=2").fetchone()
    assert tuple(row)==("COMPLETED",1)
    db2.close()
    print("[PASS] post-reward overlevel story quest skip")

def structural_contracts():
    from data.equipment_stat_policy import (
        CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES,
        CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES,
        CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES,
        CLASS_STAT_WEIGHTS,
        get_allowed_equipment_stats,
        validate_equipment_stat_policy,
    )
    import db_modules.generated_equipment as canonical
    import db_modules.shop as shop
    from systems import dynamic_equipment_system as compatibility

    classes = {"warrior", "knight", "scout", "rogue", "mage", "priest"}
    assert validate_equipment_stat_policy() == ()
    assert set(CLASS_STAT_WEIGHTS) == classes
    assert set(CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES) == classes
    assert CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES == {
        "mage": "cloth", "priest": "cloth", "scout": "leather",
        "rogue": "leather", "warrior": "chain", "knight": "plate",
    }
    assert get_allowed_equipment_stats("knight", "off_hand", item_subtype="shield") == ("sta", "str")
    assert set(get_allowed_equipment_stats("warrior", "jewelry")) <= {"str", "dex", "sta"}
    assert set(get_allowed_equipment_stats("mage", "jewelry")) <= {"int", "wis", "sta"}
    assert CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES["scout"] == ("bow_2h", "crossbow_2h")
    assert CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES["scout"] == ()

    delegates = (
        "add_primary_stat_to_stats", "add_stat_value",
        "apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats",
        "apply_armor_type_primary_stat_profile_to_stats",
        "clear_primary_stat_bonuses", "generate_dynamic_equipment_stats",
        "get_dynamic_armor_name", "get_dynamic_sell_price",
        "get_dynamic_stat_value", "get_dynamic_weapon_name",
        "get_existing_primary_stat_budget", "get_profile_for_generated_item",
        "get_random_main_hand_profile", "get_random_off_hand_profile",
        "init_dynamic_equipment_system", "normalize_equipment_restriction_value",
        "pick_weighted_stat",
    )
    for name in delegates:
        assert inspect.signature(getattr(canonical, name)) == inspect.signature(getattr(compatibility, name))

    dynamic_source = (ROOT / "systems/dynamic_equipment_system.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    shop_source = (ROOT / "db_modules/shop.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    generator_source = (ROOT / "db_modules/generated_equipment.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    ast.parse(dynamic_source)
    ast.parse(shop_source)
    ast.parse(generator_source)
    assert "from systems.dynamic_equipment_system import generate_equipment_item" not in shop_source
    assert "redistribute_primary_stat_budget(" in shop_source
    assert generator_source.count("redistribute_primary_stat_budget(") == 2
    assert "systems.dynamic_equipment_system" not in generator_source
    for forbidden in ("sqlite3", "cursor", "conn", "random.", "create_generated_equipment_item"):
        assert forbidden not in dynamic_source

    offers = shop.generate_class_shop_equipment("priest", 8)
    assert offers and all(row["target_class"] == "priest" for row in offers)
    assert callable(shop.populate_class_shop_for_user)

    return {
        "classes": sorted(classes),
        "armor_types": dict(CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES),
        "knight_shield": list(get_allowed_equipment_stats("knight", "off_hand", item_subtype="shield")),
        "delegated_functions": len(delegates),
        "legacy_missing_symbol_removed": True,
        "canonical_item_creation_owner": "db_modules/generated_equipment.py",
        "canonical_policy_owner": "data/equipment_stat_policy.py",
        "thin_compatibility_module": "systems/dynamic_equipment_system.py",
    }

def main():
    for relative in PRODUCTION_FILES + MAINTAINED_TESTS:
        path = ROOT / relative
        if not path.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError(f"Required closure file missing: {relative}")
        if path.suffix == ".py":
            ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))

    commands = []
    commands.append(run([sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", *[str(ROOT / path) for path in PRODUCTION_FILES + MAINTAINED_TESTS]]))
    structure = structural_contracts()
    for relative in MAINTAINED_TESTS:
        commands.append(run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / relative)]))

    parity = json.loads((ROOT / "reports/stage_18_17_3_equipment_drop_shop_parity.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    behavior = json.loads((ROOT / "reports/stage_18_17_7_dynamic_equipment_behavioral_fixtures.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert parity["status"] == "PASS" and parity["matrix_rows"] == 58 and parity["samples_per_row"] == 200
    assert parity["routes"]["purchase_reroll"] is False
    assert behavior["status"] == "PASS" and behavior["behavioral_parity"] is True and behavior["total_fixtures"] == 1950

    commits = commit_check()
    database = database_check()
    assert database["quick_check"] == "ok"
    assert database["foreign_key_violations"] == []
    assert database["total_changes"] == 0
    assert database["unchanged"] is True

    report = {
        "stage": "18.17.9",
        "status": "CLOSED",
        "generated_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "production_mutation": False,
        "manual_acceptance": {
            "status": "PASS",
            "reported_by_user": True,
            "scenarios": [
                "base equipment shop opened after thin delegate consolidation",
                "weapon, armor, jewelry and off-hand previews worked",
                "class-appropriate stats verified with multiple classes",
                "preview and purchased item remained consistent",
                "inventory, comparison, equip, PvE and restart worked without traceback",
            ],
        },
        "structure": structure,
        "class_stat_weights": {
            "warrior": {"str": 60, "sta": 30, "dex": 10},
            "knight": {"sta": 50, "str": 45, "dex": 5},
            "scout": {"str": 45, "dex": 45, "sta": 10},
            "rogue": {"dex": 60, "str": 30, "sta": 10},
            "mage": {"int": 65, "wis": 25, "sta": 10},
            "priest": {"int": 50, "wis": 40, "sta": 10},
        },
        "invariants": {
            "existing_generated_items_migrated": False,
            "new_class_aware_drop_enabled": True,
            "new_base_shop_preview_class_aware": True,
            "shop_purchase_reroll": False,
            "rarity_multipliers_changed": False,
            "weapon_damage_changed": False,
            "armor_defense_identity_changed": False,
            "bow_crossbow_identity_preserved": True,
            "knight_shield_stats": ["sta", "str"],
            "wal_shm_manipulated": False,
        },
        "verification": {
            "maintained_tests": list(MAINTAINED_TESTS),
            "commands": commands,
            "drop_shop_matrix_rows": 58,
            "drop_shop_samples": 11600,
            "behavioral_fixtures": 1950,
            "commits": commits,
        },
        "database": database,
        "known_nuances": [
            "The class-aware policy applies to newly generated class-aware loot and new base-shop previews; existing generated items are not rewritten.",
            "Unrestricted loot remains unrestricted when class_aware_chance selects the random branch.",
            "Selection weights guide which primary stats receive existing generated stat chunks; they do not change the total stat budget.",
            "The legacy class-shop public signatures remain as read-only compatibility catalog adapters and do not populate items or previews.",
            "systems.dynamic_equipment_system remains import-compatible but delegates calculations to db_modules.generated_equipment.",
        ],
        "superseded_tests": [
            {
                "stage": "18.17.0",
                "reason": "Point-in-time audit described the pre-mutation stat mismatch and is retained as historical evidence, not a closure invariant.",
            },
            {
                "stage": "18.17.4",
                "reason": "Point-in-time compatibility audit reported duplicates and a missing legacy symbol that were intentionally resolved in 18.17.6 and 18.17.8.",
            },
            {
                "stage": "18.17.5",
                "reason": "Point-in-time legacy reachability audit justified the canonical adapter and is not rerun as a current broken-route assertion.",
            },
        ],
        "next_stage": "18.18 according to the current roadmap",
    }

    REPORT.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    MD.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    REPORT.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str), encoding="utf-8")

    lines = [
        "# Stage 18.17: Class-aware Equipment Stat Policy Production Closure",
        "",
        "**Status:** CLOSED",
        "**Manual acceptance:** PASS",
        "**Production database migration:** none",
        "",
        "## Objective",
        "",
        "Stage 18.17 makes newly generated equipment class-aware across mob loot and the base equipment shop while preserving armor defense identity, rarity budgets, weapon damage, preview-to-purchase consistency and existing player-owned items.",
        "",
        "## Authoritative architecture",
        "",
        "- `data/equipment_stat_policy.py` is the single source of class stat rules, allowed armor types, weapon subtypes, off-hand subtypes and weighted primary-stat choices.",
        "- `db_modules/generated_equipment.py` is the canonical calculation and generated-item creation owner.",
        "- `db_modules/shop.py` owns base-shop preview and purchase integration.",
        "- `systems/dynamic_equipment_system.py` is a thin lazy compatibility delegate with no SQL, balance tables, independent RNG logic or item creation.",
        "",
        "## Class profiles",
        "",
        "- Warrior: STR 60%, STA 30%, DEX 10%.",
        "- Knight: STA 50%, STR 45%, DEX 5%.",
        "- Scout: STR 45%, DEX 45%, STA 10%.",
        "- Rogue: DEX 60%, STR 30%, STA 10%.",
        "- Mage: INT 65%, WIS 25%, STA 10%.",
        "- Priest: INT 50%, WIS 40%, STA 10%.",
        "",
        "These percentages are weighted stat-selection probabilities. They are not PATK/MATK coefficients and do not increase the total generated stat budget.",
        "",
        "## Equipment rules",
        "",
        "- Mage and Priest use cloth.",
        "- Scout and Rogue use leather.",
        "- Warrior uses chain.",
        "- Knight uses plate.",
        "- Knight shield generates only STA and STR, weighted 65% and 35% for shield-specific selection.",
        "- Warrior and Knight swords may receive rare DEX as a secondary class stat.",
        "- Scout keeps both bow and crossbow subtypes.",
        "- Jewelry is class-aware: physical classes use STR/DEX/STA profiles; magical classes use INT/WIS/STA profiles.",
        "",
        "## Armor defense identity",
        "",
        "The existing armor defense distribution remains unchanged:",
        "",
        "- Cloth emphasizes MDEF.",
        "- Leather remains comparatively balanced.",
        "- Chain emphasizes PDEF.",
        "- Plate has the strongest PDEF emphasis.",
        "",
        "Class-aware primary-stat redistribution does not alter the already calculated PDEF/MDEF values.",
        "",
        "## Generation and shop flow",
        "",
        "- Class-aware mob loot applies the target character class only when the class-aware branch is selected.",
        "- Forced-slot generation and new base-shop previews always use the target user's class.",
        "- Preview creation generates the item once.",
        "- Purchase promotes the preview to a permanent generated item and does not reroll stats.",
        "- Existing generated and historical preview items are not migrated or recalculated.",
        "",
        "## Legacy route consolidation",
        "",
        "The broken legacy class-shop route no longer imports the missing `generate_equipment_item` symbol and no longer inserts a full parallel random shop into `items`. Its public functions remain available as read-only canonical offer descriptors.",
        "",
        "## Verification",
        "",
        "- Seven maintained Stage 18.17 tests PASS.",
        "- Drop/shop parity: 58 routes and 11,600 deterministic samples PASS.",
        "- Dynamic-equipment behavioral parity: 1,950 fixtures PASS.",
        "- Seventeen compatibility helpers preserve their signatures and delegate to the canonical owner.",
        "- `py_compile`, imports, structural contracts, exception contracts and RNG seed behavior PASS.",
        "- `PRAGMA quick_check`: ok.",
        "- Foreign-key violations: 0.",
        "- `game.db` remained unchanged during closure.",
        "- WAL/SHM were not manipulated.",
        "",
        "## Manual acceptance",
        "",
        "Manual verification was completed successfully after Stage 18.17.8. The base shop, class-appropriate stats, preview and purchase consistency, inventory, comparison, equip flow, PvE and restart were accepted without runtime traceback.",
        "",
        "## Known nuances",
        "",
    ]
    for nuance in report["known_nuances"]:
        lines.append(f"- {nuance}")
    lines.extend([
        "",
        "## Superseded point-in-time audits",
        "",
        "Stages 18.17.0, 18.17.4 and 18.17.5 remain historical evidence. Their pre-mutation findings are intentionally superseded by the current production invariants and are not treated as present defects.",
        "",
        "## Final decision",
        "",
        "Stage 18.17 is closed. No additional implementation patch is required unless a new runtime defect is discovered. Continue with Stage 18.18 according to the current roadmap.",
    ])
    MD.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    print(json.dumps({
        "status": "CLOSED",
        "maintained_tests": len(MAINTAINED_TESTS),
        "drop_shop_samples": 11600,
        "behavioral_fixtures": 1950,
        "manual_acceptance": "PASS",
        "db_unchanged": True,
        "json": str(REPORT.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "md": str(MD.relative_to(ROOT)),
    }, ensure_ascii=False))

def run_ci(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Execute compile, imports, unit, architecture, duplicate, and content gates."""
    checks=[_compile(root),_imports(root)]
    unit=_run(root,sys.executable,"-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests_v2","-p","test_*.py")
    checks.append({"name":"unit","status":"PASS" if unit["returncode"]==0 else "FAIL","execution":unit})
    architecture=_run(root,sys.executable,"tools/verify_v2_architecture.py","--project-root",str(root))
    checks.append({"name":"architecture","status":"PASS" if architecture["returncode"]==0 else "FAIL","execution":architecture})
    checks.extend([_duplicates(root),_content(root)])
    failed=[check["name"] for check in checks if check["status"]!="PASS"]
    return {"schema_version":1,"status":"PASS" if not failed else "FAIL","failed_checks":failed,"checks":checks}

        database.cursor.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES (3, 5, 99, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)")
        database.conn.commit()

        initial = get_attribute_point_state(1, db_module=database)
        assert initial["free_attribute_points"] == 10 and initial["invariant_valid"]
        result = allocate_attribute_points(
            1, {"str": 2, "dexterity": 1, "wis": 2},

        )
        assert result["spent"] == 5

        snapshot = get_attribute_point_state(1, db_module=database)

            c.execute(
                "INSERT INTO player_interaction_requests "
                "(id,request_type,initiator_user_id,recipient_user_id,location_snapshot,status,revision,created_at,updated_at,expires_at,responded_at) "
                "VALUES(10,'trade',1,2,'start_path','accepted',1,?,?,?,?)",
                (now.isoformat(),now.isoformat(),(now+timedelta(minutes=2)).isoformat(),now.isoformat()),
            )
            c.execute("INSERT INTO player_activity_sessions(user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(1,'trade',10,'active',?,?,NULL)",(now.isoformat(),now.isoformat()))
            c.execute("INSERT INTO player_activity_sessions(user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(2,'trade',10,'active',?,?,NULL)",(now.isoformat(),now.isoformat()))
            c.execute("INSERT INTO player_activity_sessions(user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(3,'trade_request',999,'pending',?,?,?)",(now.isoformat(),now.isoformat(),(now+timedelta(minutes=2)).isoformat()))
            c.commit()
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            fixture_count=c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_activity_sessions").fetchone()[0]
        if fixture_count != 3: fail(f"fixture persistence: {fixture_count}")
        recovered=module.recover_orphan_player_activity_sessions(now=now,db_path=db)
        if recovered["accepted_placeholder_trade_sessions"] != 2: fail(recovered)

        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            c.execute("UPDATE player_interaction_requests SET status='pending',responded_at=NULL WHERE id=10")
            c.executemany("INSERT INTO player_activity_sessions(user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(?,'trade_request',10,'pending',?,?,?)",((1,now.isoformat(),now.isoformat(),(now+timedelta(minutes=2)).isoformat()),(2,now.isoformat(),now.isoformat(),(now+timedelta(minutes=2)).isoformat())))
            c.commit()
        result=module.respond_to_player_interaction_request(10,2,"accept",expected_revision=1,now=now,db_path=db)
        if not result["success"] or result["status"]!="accepted": fail(result)
        trade = result.get("trade") or {}
        trade_id = trade.get("trade_id") or (trade.get("trade") or {}).get("id")
        if not trade_id: fail(f"accepted trade missing: {result}")
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            sessions=c.execute(
                "SELECT user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,expires_at "
                "FROM player_activity_sessions ORDER BY user_id"
            ).fetchall()
            status=c.execute("SELECT status FROM player_interaction_requests WHERE id=10").fetchone()[0]
        if len(sessions) != 2 or status != "accepted": fail(f"accepted trade sessions: {sessions}, status={status}")
        if any(row[1] != "trade" or row[2] != trade_id or row[3] != "editing" or row[4] is None for row in sessions):
            fail(f"accepted trade session contract: {sessions}")
        cancelled=module.cancel_player_trade(trade_id,1,now=now,db_path=db)
        if not cancelled.get("success"): fail(f"trade cleanup cancel: {cancelled}")
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            if c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_activity_sessions").fetchone()[0] != 0:
                fail("trade cleanup session residue")

        # Cleanup before create must remove stale placeholders and allow a fresh request.
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            c.execute("INSERT INTO player_activity_sessions(user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES(1,'trade',10,'active',?,?,NULL)",(now.isoformat(),now.isoformat()))
            c.execute("UPDATE player_interaction_requests SET status='accepted' WHERE id=10")
            c.commit()
        fresh=module.create_player_interaction_request(1,2,"trade",now=now,db_path=db)
        if not fresh["success"]: fail(fresh)
        # Confirm that Windows can obtain an exclusive DB lock before temp cleanup.
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db, timeout=1.0)) as c:
            c.execute("BEGIN EXCLUSIVE")
            c.rollback()
    main_source=(ROOT/"main.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    if "cleanup_player_interaction_state()" not in main_source: fail("startup cleanup missing")
    print("[OK] Interaction session timeout and recovery contracts")
    print("- accepted pre-editor trade sessions released: OK")
    print("- expired/orphan request sessions cleaned: OK")
    print("- cleanup runs before busy checks: OK")
    print("- accepted request stays auditable without blocking users: OK")
    print("- startup recovery registered: OK")
    print("- isolated DB; real user mutations: 0")

            "WHERE user_id=?", (USER_ID,)
        )
        columns={row[1] for row in db.conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(items)")}
        values={"id":ITEM_ID,"name":"Тестовий рунний нагрудник","type":"armor",
                "rarity":"common","category":"equipment","slot_key":"chest",
                "weapon_hands":1,"max_stack":1,"sell_price":0,"bonus_str":0,
                "bonus_dex":0,"bonus_int":0,"bonus_wis":0,"bonus_sta":0,
                "pdef":0,"mdef":0,"item_level":1,"is_generated":0,
                "item_subtype":"","armor_type":"cloth","weapon_min_damage":0,
                "weapon_max_damage":0,"weapon_min_magic_damage":0,
                "weapon_max_magic_damage":0,"weapon_attack_type":"",
                "shop_preview_owner":None,"shop_preview_price":0}
        selected=[key for key in values if key in columns]
        db.conn.execute(f"INSERT INTO items ({', '.join(selected)}) VALUES ({', '.join('?' for _ in selected)})",
                        tuple(values[key] for key in selected))
        equipment_id=int(db.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO inventory (user_id,item_id,quantity,durability) VALUES (?,?,1,100)",
            (USER_ID,ITEM_ID)).lastrowid)
        # create_user() already initializes all canonical equipment slots,
        # including chest, with inventory_id=NULL. Update that existing row
        # instead of inserting a duplicate (user_id, slot_key) pair.
        updated_slot = db.conn.execute(
            "UPDATE equipment_slots SET inventory_id=? "
            "WHERE user_id=? AND slot_key=?",
            (equipment_id, USER_ID, "chest"),
        ).rowcount
        if updated_slot != 1:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"fixture chest slot update count={updated_slot}, expected 1"
            )
        # STA III, INT IV, WIS V, STR II, DEX I
        rune_specs=((513,"STA",3),(519,"INT",4),(525,"WIS",5),(502,"STR",2),(506,"DEX",1))
        for index,(item_id,stat,level) in enumerate(rune_specs):
            db.conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO inventory_runes (inventory_id,slot_index,rune_item_id,rune_stat,rune_level) "
                "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",(equipment_id,index,item_id,stat,level))
        db.conn.commit()

        # chest normally has 3, but direct fixture uses 5 rows to verify each stat once.
        totals=db.get_equipped_rune_stat_totals(USER_ID)
        expected={"str":2,"sta":3,"dex":1,"int":4,"wis":5}
        if totals!=expected: fail(f"rune totals mismatch: {totals}")
        stats=db.get_player_stats(USER_ID)
        if stats[:5]!=(12,11,24,20,15): fail(f"player stats mismatch: {stats}")

        max_hp=db.get_max_hp(USER_ID)
        expected_hp=100+8*20+15*5
        if max_hp!=expected_hp: fail(f"Max HP mismatch: {max_hp} != {expected_hp}")
        pdef=db.get_physical_defense(USER_ID)
        if pdef!=3: fail(f"PDEF mismatch: {pdef}")
        mdef=db.get_magic_defense(USER_ID)
        if mdef!=20: fail(f"MDEF mismatch: {mdef}")
        max_mp=db.get_max_mp(USER_ID)
        expected_mp=100+8*20+24*3+20*2
        if max_mp!=expected_mp: fail(f"Max MP mismatch: {max_mp} != {expected_mp}")

        # Stored resource synchronization must clamp only, never heal to full.
        db.conn.execute("UPDATE users SET hp=100, max_hp=100, mp=80, max_mp=80 WHERE user_id=?",(USER_ID,))
        db.conn.commit()
        hp_sync=db.sync_user_max_hp(USER_ID,heal_to_full=False)
        db.refresh_user_mp(USER_ID)
        row=db.conn.execute("SELECT hp,max_hp,mp,max_mp FROM users WHERE user_id=?",(USER_ID,)).fetchone()
        if tuple(row)!=(100,expected_hp,80,expected_mp): fail(f"resource no-heal sync mismatch: {row}")

        # Broken equipment disables all rune bonuses.
        db.conn.execute("UPDATE inventory SET durability=0 WHERE id=?",(equipment_id,));db.conn.commit()
        broken=db.get_equipped_rune_stat_totals(USER_ID)
        if any(broken.values()): fail(f"broken item rune bonuses remain: {broken}")
        broken_stats=db.get_player_stats(USER_ID)
        if broken_stats[:5]!=(10,10,20,15,12): fail(f"broken stats mismatch: {broken_stats}")

        # Unequipped equipment also disables rune bonuses.
        db.conn.execute("UPDATE inventory SET durability=100 WHERE id=?",(equipment_id,))
        db.conn.execute("DELETE FROM equipment_slots WHERE user_id=?",(USER_ID,));db.conn.commit()
        unequipped=db.get_equipped_rune_stat_totals(USER_ID)
        if any(unequipped.values()): fail(f"unequipped rune bonuses remain: {unequipped}")

        print("[OK] Rune character stat bonus contracts")
        print("- STR/STA/DEX/INT/WIS rune totals: exact once")
        print("- equipped + durability >0 requirement: OK")
        print("- unequipped rune bonuses: 0")
        print("- broken equipment rune bonuses: 0")
        print("- Max HP / PDEF from STA: OK")
        print("- Max MP / MDEF from INT/WIS: OK")
        print("- physical/magical crit inherit DEX/WIS: canonical stat path")
        print("- resource sync free healing: 0")
    finally:
        cleanup(db)
    print("- isolated fixture cleanup: OK")
    print("- real user mutations: 0")

def db_snapshot():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB.resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True)
    try:
        columns = {row[1] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(users)")}
        required_columns = {
            "free_attribute_points", "total_attribute_points_earned",
            "allocated_strength", "allocated_dexterity", "allocated_intelligence",
            "allocated_wisdom", "allocated_stamina", "attribute_points_migrated_at",
            "pending_class_change_inventory_id",
        }
        users = conn.execute("""SELECT user_id,level,free_attribute_points,total_attribute_points_earned,
            allocated_strength,allocated_dexterity,allocated_intelligence,allocated_wisdom,allocated_stamina
            FROM users ORDER BY user_id""").fetchall()
        invariant_errors = []
        for row in users:
            user_id, level, free, earned, strength, dexterity, intelligence, wisdom, stamina = row
            allocated = sum(int(value or 0) for value in (strength,dexterity,intelligence,wisdom,stamina))
            if int(earned or 0) != int(free or 0) + allocated:
                invariant_errors.append({"user_id":user_id,"level":level,"free":free,"earned":earned,"allocated":allocated})
        items = conn.execute("SELECT id,name,type,category,max_stack,sell_price FROM items WHERE id IN (501,504) ORDER BY id").fetchall()
        migrations = [row[0] for row in conn.execute("SELECT migration_name FROM schema_migrations ORDER BY migration_name")]
        audit_count = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attribute_respec_events").fetchone()[0]
        return {
            "quick_check": conn.execute("PRAGMA quick_check").fetchone()[0],
            "foreign_key_violations": conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall(),
            "required_columns_missing": sorted(required_columns - columns),
            "users_checked": len(users),
            "ledger_invariant_errors": invariant_errors,
            "items": items,
            "migrations": migrations,
            "attribute_respec_events": audit_count,
            "total_changes": conn.total_changes,
        }
    finally:
        conn.close()

    before_sha = sha(DB)

    results = []
    missing = [rel for rel in REQUIRED_TESTS if not (ROOT/rel).is_file()]
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Required Stage 18.16 smoke tests missing: {missing}")
    for rel in REQUIRED_TESTS:
        proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT/rel)], cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True)
        results.append({"test":rel,"returncode":proc.returncode,"stdout":proc.stdout[-4000:],"stderr":proc.stderr[-4000:]})
        if proc.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Stage 18.16 smoke test failed: {rel}")
    imports = []
    for name in REQUIRED_IMPORTS:
        importlib.import_module(name)
        imports.append(name)
    from data.drop_tables import DROP_RULES_BY_ID, CENTRAL_DROP_VICTORY_RULE_ORDER
    from data.rebirth_sphere_policy import get_sphere_economic_policy
    from systems.drop_system import get_victory_drop_plan, validate_drop_tables
    from systems.premium_item_policy_system import PREMIUM_ITEM_POLICY, DENIED_TRANSFER_ITEM_IDS
    rule = DROP_RULES_BY_ID.get("rebirth_sphere")
    if not rule:
        raise RuntimeError("rebirth_sphere drop rule missing")
    expected_chances = {"normal":{"chance":0.0002},"elite":{"chance":0.001},"boss":{"chance":0.01}}
    if rule.get("enemy") != expected_chances or rule.get("item_id") != 504 or not rule.get("production_enabled"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"rebirth_sphere drop contract drifted: {rule}")
    if tuple(CENTRAL_DROP_VICTORY_RULE_ORDER) != tuple(get_victory_drop_plan()) or get_victory_drop_plan()[-1] != "rebirth_sphere":
        raise RuntimeError("central victory plan drifted")
    if not validate_drop_tables()["success"]:
        raise RuntimeError("central drop schema invalid")
    new_path = get_sphere_economic_policy(501)
    rebirth = get_sphere_economic_policy(504)
    policy_ok = (
        501 in PREMIUM_ITEM_POLICY and 501 in DENIED_TRANSFER_ITEM_IDS
        and 504 not in PREMIUM_ITEM_POLICY and 504 not in DENIED_TRANSFER_ITEM_IDS
        and new_path["mob_drop_eligible"] is False and new_path["crystal_shop_eligible"] is True
        and rebirth["mob_drop_eligible"] is True and rebirth["crystal_shop_eligible"] is False
        and rebirth["tradeable"] is True and rebirth["auctionable"] is True
    )
    after_sha = sha(DB)
    verdict = (
        db["quick_check"] == "ok" and not db["foreign_key_violations"]
        and not db["required_columns_missing"] and not db["ledger_invariant_errors"]
        and db["total_changes"] == 0 and before_sha == after_sha and policy_ok
    )
    report = {
        "stage":"18.16.11",
        "generated_at_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "status":"PASS" if verdict else "FAIL",
        "production_mutation":False,
        "database_sha256_before":before_sha,
        "database_sha256_after":after_sha,
        "database":db,
        "smoke_tests":results,
        "smoke_test_count":len(results),
        "superseded_tests_not_run":list(SUPERSEDED_TESTS),
        "imports":imports,
        "sphere_policy_ok":policy_ok,
        "drop_rule":rule,
        "victory_plan":list(get_victory_drop_plan()),
        "known_nuances":[
            "The Stage 18.16.1 foundation smoke test is superseded because it requires every ledger value to remain zero; closure validates schema and the live ledger invariant directly.",
            "The Stage 18.16.10e audit smoke test is superseded because production drop is now enabled.",
            "Natural drop frequency is too low for practical manual hit testing; deterministic boundary tests are authoritative.",
            "Rebirth Sphere NPC sell_price remains 0.0; player auction and direct trade are supported.",

def main():
    checks = []
    stat_path = ROOT / "systems" / "stat_system.py"
    stat_source = stat_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    ast.parse(stat_source)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
    from systems.stat_system import resolve_basic_attack_type
    actual = {key: resolve_basic_attack_type(key) for key in CLASSES}
    checks.append({"name": "six_class_basic_attack_matrix", "status": "PASS" if actual == CLASSES else "FAIL", "actual": actual})

    from data.priest_healing_policy import (
        PRIEST_HEALING_COOLDOWN_TURNS,
        PRIEST_HEALING_DURATION_TURNS,
        PRIEST_HEALING_IMMEDIATE_HEALS,
        PRIEST_HEALING_TOTAL_HEALS,
        build_priest_healing_effect,
        calculate_priest_heal_amount,
    )
    priest_ok = (
        PRIEST_HEALING_IMMEDIATE_HEALS == 1
        and PRIEST_HEALING_DURATION_TURNS == 2
        and PRIEST_HEALING_TOTAL_HEALS == 3
        and PRIEST_HEALING_COOLDOWN_TURNS == 4
        and build_priest_healing_effect(calculate_priest_heal_amount(130))["turns"] == 2
    )
    checks.append({"name": "priest_healing_contract", "status": "PASS" if priest_ok else "FAIL"})

    combat = (ROOT / "handlers" / "combat.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    cooldown_ok = (
        'mob["skill_cooldowns"][skill_key] = cooldown_turns + 1' not in combat
        and 'mob["skill_cooldowns"][skill_key] = cooldown_turns' in combat
    )
    checks.append({
        "name": "priest_visible_cooldown_regression",
        "status": "PASS" if cooldown_ok else "FAIL",
    })

    maintained = [execute(path) for path in MAINTAINED]
    evidence = [read_json(path) for path in EVIDENCE]
    available_maintained = [item for item in maintained if item["status"] != "MISSING"]
    maintained_ok = bool(available_maintained) and all(item["status"] == "PASS" for item in available_maintained)
    checks.append({"name": "maintained_suite", "status": "PASS" if maintained_ok else "FAIL", "available": len(available_maintained)})
    parity_path = "tools/verify_stage_20_2_3_pvp_simulator_basic_attack_parity.py"
    parity_result = next((item for item in maintained if item["path"] == parity_path), None)
    parity_ok = parity_result is not None and parity_result.get("status") == "PASS"
    checks.append({
        "name": "pvp_simulator_runtime_parity",
        "status": "PASS" if parity_ok else "FAIL",
        "authority": parity_path,
    })

    db_result = {"present": False, "status": "NOT_APPLICABLE"}
    db_path = ROOT / "game.db"
    if db_path.is_file():
        uri = db_path.resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro"
        connection = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True)
        try:
            quick = [row[0] for row in connection.execute("PRAGMA quick_check")]
            foreign = list(connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check"))
            db_result = {
                "present": True, "mode": "ro", "quick_check": quick,
                "foreign_key_errors": len(foreign),
                "status": "PASS" if quick == ["ok"] and not foreign else "FAIL",
            }
        finally:
            connection.close()
    checks.append({"name": "database_invariants", "status": db_result["status"]})

    automated_pass = all(item["status"] in {"PASS", "NOT_APPLICABLE"} for item in checks)
    payload = {
        "stage": "20.2.6",
        "automated_status": "PASS" if automated_pass else "FAIL",
        "acceptance_status": "MANUAL_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED" if automated_pass else "BLOCKED_AUTOMATED_FAIL",
        "checks": checks,
        "maintained_suite": maintained,
        "prior_evidence": evidence,
        "database": db_result,
        "manual_gate": {
            "required": True,
            "scenarios": [
                "Mage basic attack PvE",
                "Priest basic attack and healing PvE",
                "One physical class basic attack PvE",
                "One magical and one physical class PvP",
                "Simulator sanity for all six classes",
            ],
        },
    }
    print(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False))
    return 0 if automated_pass else 1

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--project-root", default=".")
    parser.add_argument("--contract", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--json-out")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = verify(Path(args.project_root).resolve(), json.loads(Path(args.contract).read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
    text = json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"
    if args.json_out: Path(args.json_out).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print(f"V2 Clock/RNG verifier: {result['summary']['status']}")
    print(f"Clock owners: {result['summary']['clock_owner_count']}")
    print(f"RNG owners: {result['summary']['rng_owner_count']}")
    print(f"Direct time calls: {result['summary']['direct_time_call_count']}")
    print(f"Direct RNG calls: {result['summary']['direct_rng_call_count']}")
    print(f"Violations: {result['summary']['violation_count']}")
    return 0 if result["summary"]["status"] == "PASS" else 1
